title: Fixed Riffled Ore Dressing Table
description: One original complete static ore-dressing table appearance: a broad uninterrupted solid mildly cross-sloped deck carries twelve whole progressively shortened raised riffles, a high side and feed-end guard, and one lower-side open-ended collection launder. Four whole grounded legs with inclined top seats and three lower frame ties support the deck. This is not a grizzly screen with through-slots, twin-valley splitter or spiral basin; no old model is imported or rescaled. One independent prop. Empty fixed equipment only: no actual shaking drive, water, ore, separation, recovery yield, flow simulation, powered operation, strength, accessibility, manufacture or safety claim.
